verdicts.rationale: 'The psychology of language' (Fodor, Bever & Garrett 1974, McGraw-Hill) is a different book from 'The language of thought' (Fodor 1975, Harvard). Different titles, years, publishers, and ISBNs.
'The psychology of language' (1974, McGraw-Hill) vs 'The language of thought' (1975, Crowell) are distinct works with different titles, years, and ISBNs.

Both are Fodor's 'The Language of Thought' (1975), Harvard University Press (Cambridge, MA). The -2 entry just embeds the publisher in the title field. Same work.
